profile.headline: Software Engineer at S&P Global Market Intelligence
profile.summary:
Avid developer that strives for succinct, correct, beautiful code. I resonate with Abelson & Sussman when they say that “programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.” 

Having worked for a start-up for most of my professional career, I have experience at all levels of the development stack.  I helped save my previous employer multiple thousands dollars by researching and implementing open source solutions to business problems.  I’m a strong advocate of programmer and team efficiency, and have mentored others and implemented solutions to enhance productivity with tools such as: distributed version control tools, automated test suites, continuous build system, better bug tracking systems, use of Linq (functional tools in .NET), amongst others.

Specialties: C#, Linq, Object Oriented solutions, Functional Programming solutions, SQL (and T-SQL), Web framework creation, Data Access layer creation, Business Logic code

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-developed the company's flagship web-based product (an applicant tracking,
       selection and hiring system for human resources departments which sorts and
       filters applicants based on an array of criteria); also helped to develop supporting
       database and ancillary tools.

       Mentored other team members in the use of cygwin, different command line tools, Linux, and other open source tools.  Championed use of .NET's extension methods, and Linq which are now used extensively in production code.

       Developed multiple SOAP and restful web services for third party affiliates.

       Wrote a myriad of supporting tools using different technologies, such as: python,
       MS Office integration APIs, OpenOffice APIs, C# and F#, command line utilities,
       bash scripting, windows services, and others.

       Participated on the team responsible for defining and implementing the
       company's software development process.

       Managed setup, operation, maintenance and customization of company's internal
       wiki (MoinMoin), bug tracking system (Trac), firewall (IPTables), version control
       system (Mercurial server), Linux servers, Apache servers, IIS, MSSQL, amongst
       others.

       Was responsible for multiple aspects of SAS-70 certification.

positions.title: Network Programmer
positions.description:
Assisted in development of the university's Network Control Center for
       automated creation and management of network connections, using technologies
       such as: C, Perl, PHP, MySQL, shell scripting, HTML+CSS.

       Assisted in development of SNMP monitoring tools.

positions.title: Independent Development
positions.description:
Developed a user account management system with support for multiple
       platforms for a local ISP. The system has a Perl/MySQL back-end, and a PHP/
       HTML front-end.

projects.title: Haskell Weekly News
projects.description:
The Haskell Weekly News tries to be a helpful resource for those who would like to keep an eye on what is happening in the Haskell community, but lack the time to poll the net every day for interesting happenings.

Every issue is read by more than 700 people on the website, and probably sever hundred others who receive it via the haskell or haskell-cafe mailing list.
